thesis: Pre-open headlines for 2026-09-10 reflect intensifying macro and energy headwinds, with oil prices jumping back above $100 per barrel as the Iran war escalates, Strait of Hormuz blockade disruptions widening, and Wall Street indices under pressure. Company-specific news items in the pack (STX, Delek, Adecoagro, Nebius, Standard Lithium, Bloom Energy, Intel price hike talk) are diffuse or outside our universe, offering no clear high-conviction catalyst for rotation. Our balanced 4-position portfolio—anchored by broad equity core VTI, fixed-income ballast BND, and growth/semiconductor exposure in NVDA and XLK—remains diversified (cap 6), keeps all single-name positions well below the 35% cap (VTI ~28%, NVDA ~18%), and preserves $35.00 cash (~32% of equity vs the 15% floor) to absorb geopolitical, inflation, and rate volatility without forced turnover.
